|strategy=By Boone Adkins<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040810105653/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/light/small/sonofskywalker.html</ref>

[[Son Of Skywalker]] is a great card. For game players: He is a little bit restricted and costly in deployment, but it’s worth what you get. The power of five is high and an ability of five is good and it allows a battle destiny. Also, that ability allows a good chance for a successful destiny draw for [[Sense]] and [[Alter]]. And last, that ability of five helps with Jedi tests. Now don't be sad about having to deploy only on Dagobah or Cloud City.

That restriction can be of some use. You can deploy him on Dagobah, regardless of the location deployment restrictions, a useful thing for Jedi training. Like the typical pilot, [[Son Of Skywalker]] adds two to the power of any starship he pilots. He is immune to attrition less than four. And last, you can deploy a lightsaber to the same location as [[Son Of Skywalker]].

Combos:

[[Son Of Skywalker]] + Any card that allows you to peek at the top of your Reserve Deck - a guaranteed good battle destiny.

[[Son Of Skywalker]] + [[Courage Of A Skywalker]] (In hand) + [[This Is More Like It]] (In hand) + [[Smoke Screen]] (In hand) - Lots of laughs for you, your opponent looses tons of force!

[[Son Of Skywalker]] + [[Chewbacca]] + [[Wookiee Strangle]] + Jedi tests + Apprentice + Lots of [[At Peace]] cards - Now [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] gets choked for a change!

Son Of Sky walker + Teamwork cards and their partners - A heck of a lot of attrition and battle damage

Escorted [[Son Of Skywalker]] + [[Captive Fury]] (Lost function) - Bye Bye [[Bounty]] Hunter!
|combos=* [[Son Of Skywalker]] + Encampment Deploy regardless of location deployment restrictions.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Son%20Of%20Skywalker Scomp: Son Of Skywalker]; card data [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661e). |rulings=* Dagobah cloud sectors are on Dagobah, so [[Son Of Skywalker]] may deploy there (but not to the Dagobah system).<ref name="scomp" />
* [[Bespin]] cloud sectors are ''not'' on Cloud City, so [[Son Of Skywalker]] may ''not'' deploy there or to the [[Bespin]] system.
* In brief: [[Son Of Skywalker]] may deploy to Dagobah sites, Dagobah clouds, and Cloud City sites.

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the stat boxes and the deploy and forfeit numbers) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-L-sonofskywalker-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Son Of Skywalker (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the previous version. The slip no longer prints the title in its black strip; the “E” stays at the lower right.

The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip, both as cut from their sheets at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
